name: What factors influence the cost of interior finish carpentry and trim?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of interior finish carpentry and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total price depends on the linear footage, the complexity of the molding profile, room layout, and whether finishing is included. Straight runs of simple baseboard cost significantly less than multi-piece crown molding or detailed wall wainscoting. Rooms with numerous outside corners, vaulted ceilings, or uneven drywall require meticulous scribe cuts and coping, which increases labor time. A comprehensive quote typically covers material acquisition, accurate carpentry cuts, pneumatic fastening, caulking, filling nail holes, and final paint or stain touch-ups.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on linear footage, material choice, ceiling heights, profile complexity, and the labor required for caulking, filling nail holes, and painting.
